entries.title: Hebrews 4:1
segments: Let us fear therefore, lest haply, a promise being left of entering into his rest, any one of you should seem to have come short of it.

entries.title: Hebrews 4:2
segments: For indeed we have had good tidings preached unto us, even as also they: but the word of hearing did not profit them, because it was not united by faith with them that heard.

entries.title: Hebrews 4:3
segments: For we who have believed do enter into that rest; even as he hath said, As I sware in my wrath, They shall not enter into my rest: although the works were finished from the foundation of the world.

entries.title: Hebrews 4:4
segments: For he hath said somewhere of the seventh [day] on this wise, And God rested on the seventh day from all his works;

entries.title: Hebrews 4:5
segments: and in this [place] again, They shall not enter into my rest.

entries.title: Hebrews 4:6
segments: Seeing therefore it remaineth that some should enter thereinto, and they to whom the good tidings were before preached failed to enter in because of disobedience,

entries.title: Hebrews 4:7
segments: he again defineth a certain day, To-day, saying in David so long a time afterward (even as hath been said before), To-day if ye shall hear his voice, Harden not your hearts.

entries.title: Hebrews 4:8
segments: For if Joshua had given them rest, he would not have spoken afterward of another day.

entries.title: Hebrews 4:9
segments: There remaineth therefore a sabbath rest for the people of God.

entries.title: Hebrews 4:10
segments: For he that is entered into his rest hath himself also rested from his works, as God did from his.

entries.title: Hebrews 4:11
segments: Let us therefore give diligence to enter into that rest, that no man fall after the same example of disobedience.

entries.title: Hebrews 4:12
segments: For the word of God is living, and active, and sharper than any two-edged sword, and piercing even to the dividing of soul and spirit, of both joints and marrow, and quick to discern the thoughts and intents of the heart.

entries.title: Hebrews 4:13
segments: And there is no creature that is not manifest in his sight: but all things are naked and laid open before the eyes of him with whom we have to do.

entries.title: Hebrews 4:14
segments: Having then a great high priest, who hath passed through the heavens, Jesus the Son of God, let us hold fast our confession.

entries.title: Hebrews 4:15
segments: For we have not a high priest that cannot be touched with the feeling of our infirmities; but one that hath been in all points tempted like as [we are, yet] without sin.

entries.title: Hebrews 4:16
segments: Let us therefore draw near with boldness unto the throne of grace, that we may receive mercy, and may find grace to help [us] in time of need.
